welcome.text1: Plan your money months ahead, and see where it actually went.
welcome.text2: A private, open-source budget planner. Write down your income, bills, savings and transfers once, and MrMetis lays out the coming months for you. Every payment you add is set against the plan.
welcome.demoNote: No account needed. The demo comes with a sample household budget and stays in your browser.

screenshots.planning: Planning table with planned and actual amounts for each budget item, month by month
screenshots.budgetEdit: Budget editor: savings are what is left after spending, loans and transfers
screenshots.quickAdd: Quick add: budget, account, date, amount and comment filled from the keyboard

planAhead.text: See every budget item month by month, planned next to actual. What is left at the end of a month rolls into the next.

formulas.text: Build an amount from other budget items, type totals or the days in a month. When something changes, the plan follows.

quickAdd.text: Type a few letters, press Tab, and quick add fills in the budget, account, date and amount for you.

dashboard.text: Current balance on every account, what is left to spend in each budget, and this month's statements.

accounts.text: Keep a main account, a credit card and cash, and plan the transfers between them.

export.text: Export to CSV or JSON at any time and import it back. You are never locked in.

formulas.header: Savings that are whatever is left
formulas.text: An amount can be built from numbers, other budget items, totals of a type, days or weekdays in the month, from this month or the last. Combine them with + − × ÷ and brackets. Items can repeat every few months, start and end on set dates, and be overridden for a single month.

quickAdd.text: Quick add sits at the top of every page. Type "gro", Tab, "credit", Tab, "12.5", Tab, "yesterday", Tab, add a comment and press Enter.

noBank.text: MrMetis never asks for your bank credentials. No ads, no tracking, no selling of data.

privacy.text1: Your data is yours. We will not share it with anyone.
privacy.text2: Our database stores in plain text only your e-mail. The rest is encrypted before it leaves your device.
privacy.text3: Anything we store on your device is related to functionality of the site only.

encryption.summary: Your budget is encrypted in your browser before it is sent to us, with a key made from your password. We store it, but we can't read it.

password.header: Your password stays in the browser
password.text: When you register or log in, your browser turns your password into a 256-bit master key with PBKDF2-SHA256, using 600,000 iterations and a random salt. The many iterations make guessing passwords slow. Your password itself is never sent.

split.header: The master key is split in two
split.text: HKDF turns the master key into two independent keys: one to log in with, and one to protect your data. Knowing the first tells nothing about the second.

auth.header: Only the login key is sent
auth.text: Your browser sends the login key instead of your password. The server hashes it once more before storing it, just like a normal password.

dataKey.header: A random key for your data
dataKey.text: When you register, your browser creates a random 256-bit data key. It is encrypted (wrapped) with the second key from step 2, and only that wrapped copy is stored on the server.

save.text: Before your budget is sent, it is encrypted with the data key using AES-256-GCM and a fresh random value each time. GCM also detects if anyone has changed the stored data.

login.text: When you log in, the server returns your salt and wrapped key. Your browser derives the keys again, unwraps the data key and keeps it in the browser so that scripts can use it but can't read it. It is removed when you log out.

email.how: Readable, so you can log in

authHash.how: Hashed, the key itself is not stored

wrappedKey.how: Encrypted with a key only your browser can make

meaning.cantRead: We can't read your budget, and nobody with access to our server can either.
meaning.leak: If our database ever leaked, it would contain your e-mail and encrypted data, but not your budget.
meaning.forgotten: We can't reset your password for you: without it, your data can't be decrypted. Choose a password you will remember, and export your data from time to time.
meaning.device: Anyone using your browser while you are logged in can see your data, as with any app. You are logged out automatically after some time without activity.
meaning.demo: Demo data is not encrypted. It is not sent anywhere and stays only in your browser.

encryption.verifyText: MrMetis is open source and uses only the encryption built into your browser (Web Crypto). You don't have to take our word for it: all of the above is in the code.
encryption.verifyLink: See the encryption code on GitHub
